art_handoff_hint: Art Studio adapts shared pattern settings for composition. Your experiments and observations stay here.
brightness_description: Two gray squares on different backgrounds. Adjust the backgrounds, then compare without them.
brightness_explanation: Both center squares use the same RGB fill. Surrounding light and dark regions can change apparent brightness. The drawing values describe this image, not a calibrated measurement of your display.
brightness_match_description: A fixed gray square on the left and an adjustable gray square on the right. Match their apparent brightness by eye.
brightness_match_result: Left RGB {reference}; right RGB {comparison}. Difference: {difference} RGB-code steps.
cafeWall_description: Alternating dark and light square tiles separated by gray mortar. Shift every second row.
cafeWall_explanation: All mortar bands are horizontal and parallel. Staggered tiles can make the bands look tilted. Try aligned rows or change the mortar width; the strength of the effect may change.
cafeWall_question: How do the horizontal mortar bands look?
cafeWall_result: Every mortar guide has identical start and end height.
comparison_pinned: Current settings pinned. Adjust the experiment to compare.
comparison_viewer_hint: Choose trials and guides for A and B independently. Both drawings use the same scale. Saved observations stay unchanged.
delete_saved_study_hint: This removes all {count} retained observations in this saved study. Other observations stay in place. One Undo is available after deleting.
drawing_viewer_hint: Choose a trial and toggle measurement guides. Saved observations stay unchanged.
drawing_viewer_unavailable: The enlarged drawing could not open. You can still inspect it in the recorded drawing panel.
ebbinghaus_description: Orange circles surrounded by different rings of blue circles. Change the surrounding circle size or gap.
ebbinghaus_explanation: The two orange circles keep the same diameter. Size judgments can change with the surrounding circles. Remove the surroundings and compare your impression with the outlines.
ebbinghaus_match_description: A fixed orange circle on the left and an adjustable orange circle on the right. Match their apparent size by eye.
ebbinghaus_question: Which orange center circle looks larger?
equal_scale_hint: Both drawings use the same scale. Matching target values stay hidden in each view until that view is revealed.
export_unavailable: Export could not be created. Try again.
focus_hint: Adjust the live experiment here. Closing this view keeps your drawing, notes, and layout.
focus_unavailable: The focused view could not open. Your experiment is still available in the workspace.
geometry_match_result: Reference: {reference} units; comparison: {comparison} units. Difference: {difference} units ({percent}% of the reference).
guided_capacity: Make room for three new matches by deleting observations you no longer need. Existing observations are kept until you delete them.
guided_collecting: One-setting repeat: the baseline reference and starting positions are preserved. The two studies will be selected for comparison after the third match.
guided_complete: Three new matches recorded. The baseline and new study are selected for comparison. Reveal each study separately when you are ready.
guided_hidden_context: Surroundings are removed in this baseline. Make them visible to compare their effect.
guided_hint: Use this saved study as the baseline. Choose one surrounding setting to change. The reference and three starting positions stay the same.
guided_inactive: Choose a setting that changes the visible surroundings.
guided_invalid_value: Choose a value within the setting range.
guided_plan_expired: The baseline or plan changed. Review the saved study and plan the repeat again; recorded matches remain in the notebook.
guided_ready: The new study changes only this setting. The reference and three starting positions stay fixed.
guided_start_hint: Starting opens this experiment and locks its surroundings for three new matches. Your pinned drawing is kept.
guided_unchanged: Choose a different value or state before starting.
hidden_match_value: {position} percent of adjustment range; drawing values hidden until reveal.
import_capacity: This import needs {count} spaces; {available} are available. Delete observations you no longer need, then preview the file again.
import_empty: This notebook has no observations to add.
import_expired: The notebook changed. Preview the file again before adding observations.
import_group_copies: Overlapping repeated studies will be added as separate copies, keeping their matches together.
import_hidden_hint: Saved reveal states are preserved. Hidden drawing values stay hidden.
import_hint: Preview an exported notebook before adding its observations. Existing observations stay saved; the current drawing and pinned view are kept.
import_json: This file is not valid JSON. Choose an exported Perception Lab notebook.
import_large: Choose a notebook file of 512 KiB or less.
import_preview_ready: Notebook preview ready. Review the counts before adding observations.
import_read: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
import_records: This notebook contains invalid observations or more than 24 records. No observations were added.
import_schema: Choose a Perception Lab notebook exported as version 1 JSON.
import_unchanged: All observations in this file are already saved.
import_undone: Imported observations removed. The previous notebook is restored.
intro: Explore how an image and its surroundings shape what you see. Make a prediction, change one variable, then reveal the drawing.
match_explanation: The difference records your visual match under these settings. Remove or swap the surroundings to see whether your impression changes. Different people, displays, and viewing conditions can give different matches.
match_hint: Keep the reference fixed. Adjust the right or bottom target until it looks like the reference, then reveal the drawing values.
matching_art_handoff_hint: Art Studio uses the reference gray for both center squares. Your unequal visual match is kept in Perception Lab.
matching_circle_gap_hint: Ring positions stay fixed while you match. The gap setting leaves room for the largest comparison circle.
moire_description: Two line grids overlap. Rotate the second grid or change their shared spacing.
moire_explanation: Moiré bands emerge from overlapping repeated patterns. These larger structures are present in the combined image; they are not merely imagined motion. Hide the second grid to inspect the first.
moire_question: What structure do the overlapping lines suggest?
moire_result: Two grids share a spacing of {spacing} drawing units; their angle is {angle}°.
mullerLyer_description: Two horizontal shafts with different arrowhead arrangements. Adjust the fins while observing the shafts.
mullerLyer_explanation: The horizontal shafts have identical endpoints and lengths. Changing the surrounding fins can change apparent length. The guides measure the shafts, excluding their fins.
mullerLyer_match_description: A fixed horizontal shaft at the top and an adjustable shaft below. Match their apparent length by eye; exclude the fins.
necker_description: A wireframe cube with two possible depth interpretations. Compare it with optional face cues.
necker_explanation: A flat wireframe can support more than one depth interpretation. Face cues are hints added to this drawing; they do not establish a single correct interpretation of the original ambiguous figure.
necker_result: The unshaded drawing has no unique front face.
note_placeholder: What changed when you adjusted the surroundings?
notebook_action_expired: The notebook changed. That observation action is no longer available.
notebook_actions_hint: Pin a saved observation to compare it with your current drawing. Deleting an observation offers one undo; export saves your notebook as JSON.
notebook_empty: Choose an impression and save your first observation.
notebook_group_counts: Studies shown: {shown} of {total}. Retained observations shown: {records}.
notebook_hint: This notebook holds up to 24 observations. New observations need one available space; new three-match studies need three. Existing observations stay until you delete them.
notebook_imported: Import complete. Added to your notebook: {count}. Undo import is available.
notebook_no_matches: No saved observations match these filters. Clear or change the filters to see your notebook.
notebook_no_studies: No repeated studies are saved yet. Use All observations to review individual observations, or start three matches in a matching experiment.
notebook_no_study_matches: No saved studies match these filters. Clear or change the filters to see your studies.
notebook_search_hint: Search visible experiment titles, impressions, and notes. Repeated-study observations stay together when any retained match fits the filters. Hidden drawing values are not searched.
notebook_spaces_needed: This action needs {required} available spaces; {free} remain. Export your notebook or delete observations you no longer need to make room.
notebook_undo_capacity: Undo needs {count} available spaces; {free} remain. No observations were changed.
observation_deleted: Observation deleted. Undo deletion is available.
observation_hint: Record your impression. You can revise it; this is an observation, not a scored test.
open_lab: Explore interactive illusions in Perception Lab
pair_conflict: One study has conflicting settings or duplicate trials. Review its observations individually.
pair_experiment: Choose studies from the same experiment.
pair_hidden: Reveal each study separately to see the comparison. Selecting a study does not reveal its drawing values.
pair_inactive_hint: Surroundings were removed in both studies. Settings marked Inactive did not change the displayed targets.
pair_incomplete: Both studies need three retained matches before they can be compared.
pair_instructions: Study A is the study reviewed above. Select a second study with the same experiment and fixed reference. Their drawing values stay hidden until each study is revealed.
pair_missing_option: Selected study is no longer in the notebook
pair_multiple_changes: Several surrounding settings differ. This comparison does not isolate the effect of one variable.
pair_no_compatible: There is no compatible pair available yet. Both studies need three consistent matches with the same experiment and reference.
pair_plot_hint: Dots are individual matches; solid vertical marks are medians. The dashed line is the fixed reference. Both rows use the same scale; its bounds are shown below.
pair_plot_title: Three matches and the median of each study, on one shared drawing-value scale.
pair_reference: These studies use different fixed references. Repeat the settings with the same reference to compare them.
pair_reference_value: Both studies use the same fixed reference: {value} {unit}.
pair_same_settings: The two studies used the same surrounding settings. Their matches can still vary.
pair_start_changes: These studies used different starting positions. Keep that difference in mind when comparing their matches.
pair_summary_hint: Compare the three matches and ranges as well as the medians. Two small studies describe your matches under these settings; they do not establish a general effect.
pair_table_caption: Separate results from each three-match study
recorded_drawing_hint: Inspect an actual saved match. Trial selections and guides apply only to these previews.
recorded_pair_hint: Inspect trials from each study independently. Both drawings use the same scale; each preview shows its selected recorded match.
reduced_motion_hint: Reduced motion is enabled. Use the crossing-angle slider to compare still frames.
report_not_ready: A report needs complete, consistent, revealed studies. Review the saved results before exporting.
report_print_hint: Open this file in a browser to read or print it. The report includes every recorded trial, independently of the preview selections.
report_unavailable: The study report could not be created. Try again.
saved_study_deleted: Saved study deleted: {count} observations. Undo deletion is available.
saved_study_hidden: Three matches are saved. Reveal this study to review its drawing values together.
study_all_recorded: All three matches are recorded. Reveal the results, or end the study to return to free matching.
study_comparison_selected: Comparison study selected. Each study keeps its own reveal state.
study_complete: Three matches recorded. Reveal the study results when you are ready.
study_ended: Repeated study ended. Recorded matches remain in your notebook.
study_expired: The experiment or notebook changed. The repeated study ended; recorded matches remain in the notebook.
study_frozen_hint: Surrounding settings stay fixed during this study. The notebook and pinned view return after recording or ending the study.
study_group_conflict: These matches have different settings or duplicate trial numbers. Review them individually or repeat the settings; they cannot form one study summary.
study_incomplete_group: {count} of 3 matches remain in this notebook. Review individual observations or repeat their settings to make a new study.
study_next_match: Match {trial} of 3. Adjust the comparison, choose your impression, then record it.
study_notebook_paused: Notebook observations are hidden while you make these matches. They return after recording all three matches or ending the study.
study_report_exported: Study report exported as HTML. Open it in a browser to read or print.
study_report_hint: The report includes all three recorded drawings and notes. Open the exported HTML file in a browser to read or print it.
study_results_hidden: Three matches recorded. Use Reveal study results in the controls to see their drawing values, median, and range.
study_results_revealed: All three study matches are revealed.
study_scene_progress: {count} of 3 matches recorded. Make each match by eye with the same surroundings.
study_start_hint: Try three separate matches with the reference and surroundings held fixed. Starting positions vary; numbers stay hidden until all three are recorded.
study_summary_hint: The median is the middle of your three matches; the range spans their lowest and highest values. These describe this small set of drawing matches, not a score. Try another study with different surroundings to compare your impressions.
study_trial_progress: Match {trial} of 3. Adjust the comparison and choose an impression below. Your note is saved with this match; the next match starts with a blank note.
surroundings_removed: Surroundings removed; the target drawing is unchanged.
surroundings_swapped: The two surroundings have traded places.
title: Perception Lab
viewing_hint: The viewing area uses a fixed white background to keep comparisons consistent. Different people may notice different effects.
